episodes.title: A Prime Minister's Murder, a Cult Expert, and the Moonies
episodes.description: Former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe was shot and killed in 2022. Soon after, an investigative journalist named Eito Suzuki started drawing connections between his murder and the Unification Church - whose followers are known as the “Moonies.” Phoebe interviews New Yorker writer Tammy Kim about the story. You can read Tammy Kim's piece for The New Yorker here . Don't forget that you can also watch this interview - and all of our Tuesday What Happened Next? episodes - at youtube.com/criminalpodcast. episodes.title: The Guru
episodes.description:
In the late 1960s, a yogi named Swami Rama came to the United States. His followers believed he could read their minds, visit them in their dreams, and manipulate reality. Shruti Swamy was one of them.

Shruti Swamy wrote a version of this story for the June 12th issue of The Believer. You can find it at https://www.thebeliever.net/.
